content: The playground still requires -> instead of =>, it's pretty old. Is there any reason not to update it to the latest nightly (or at least the version available from the download page)?
It just hasn't been a priority, feel free to submit a PR and post a link here.

I just submitted two PRs:

  • nightlies PR #77 to fix the upload path for the nightly echo WASM artifact.
  • www.roc-lang.org PR #155 keeps the homepage playground updated through automated nightly update PRs.
